descriptions.inProgress: You have traveled to the year 2216 on your fourth time travel. Thanks to Ken, who assumes you are from the support unit, you must eliminate monsters. Things keep coming up and hindering you from doing what you're here to do. Keep in mind that you are here for a reason.
